### Modifier keys constants

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/v2@v2.0.0-beta.6

Defines constants for modifier keys, including Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Meta, Hyper, Super, and lock keys, aliased from the uv package. Note that ModSuper corresponds to Windows/Command keys, and ModScrollLock is defined only in the Windows API.

```go
const (
	ModShift = uv.ModShift
	ModAlt   = uv.ModAlt
	ModCtrl  = uv.ModCtrl
	ModMeta  = uv.ModMeta

	ModHyper = uv.ModHyper
	ModSuper = uv.ModSuper // Windows/Command keys

	ModCapsLock   = uv.ModCapsLock
	ModNumLock    = uv.ModNumLock
	ModScrollLock = uv.ModScrollLock // Defined in Windows API only
)
```

### type MouseMode > const

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/v2@v2.0.0-beta.6

MouseModeAllMotion enables all mouse events, including click, release,
wheel, and movement events. You will receive mouse movement events even
when no buttons are pressed.

This will try to enable the mouse in extended mode (SGR), if that is not
supported by the terminal it will fall back to normal mode (X10).

### Mouse event buttons constants

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/v2@v2.0.0-beta.6

Defines constants for mouse buttons and wheel events, based on X11 mouse button codes, aliased from the uv package.

```go
const (
	MouseNone       = uv.MouseNone
	MouseLeft       = uv.MouseLeft
	MouseMiddle     = uv.MouseMiddle
	MouseRight      = uv.MouseRight
	MouseWheelUp    = uv.MouseWheelUp
	MouseWheelDown  = uv.MouseWheelDown
	MouseWheelLeft  = uv.MouseWheelLeft
	MouseWheelRight = uv.MouseWheelRight
	MouseBackward   = uv.MouseBackward
	MouseForward    = uv.MouseForward
	MouseButton10   = uv.MouseButton10
	MouseButton11
)
```

### func WithMouseCellMotion() ProgramOption

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea

Starts the program with the mouse enabled in 'cell motion' mode, capturing click, release, wheel, and drag events. Falls back to normal mode if extended mode is unsupported.

```APIDOC
## func WithMouseCellMotion() ProgramOption

### Description
Starts the program with the mouse enabled in "cell motion" mode. Cell motion mode enables mouse click, release, and wheel events. Mouse movement events are also captured if a mouse button is pressed (i.e., drag events). Cell motion mode is better supported than all motion mode. This will try to enable the mouse in extended mode (SGR), if that is not supported by the terminal it will fall back to normal mode (X10). To enable mouse cell motion once the program has already started running use the EnableMouseCellMotion command. To disable the mouse when the program is running use the DisableMouse command. The mouse will be automatically disabled when the program exits.

### Method
N/A (Go function)

### Endpoint
N/A

### Parameters
None

### Response
None
```

### WithMouseAllMotion function signature

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea

Starts the program with the mouse enabled in 'all motion' mode, delivering click, release, wheel, and motion events regardless of button state.

```go
func WithMouseAllMotion() ProgramOption
```
